title: Propagate MCP tool-call failures instead of treating them as successful text
goal: Make the Core harness MCP client honor the MCP tools/call isError result flag so a failed external tool cannot be presented to the model or caller as a successful tool result.

results.change: McpClient::call now propagates MCP tools/call results with isError=true as an EaiError containing the tool name and rendered error content; successful and JSON-RPC error paths are unchanged
results.acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-harness --lib mcp: 16 passed, 0 failed
results.boundary: Core harness protocol correctness only; no dependency, Commercial, Minijinja, release, or credential changes
